notes.title: Version 0.6.21 is here, bringing you a simplified mana system.
notes.content:
- The current mana system seemed good in theory, but didn't turn out so well in practice. We have simplified it by removing the need to manually assign mana to units. Instead, units spend mana through a shared pool, removing the need of first assigning it before you can use it.

- Players have a max value cap of 15 mana, encouraging players to spend it, rather than hoard it.

- Compensation mana is now granted to players when a unit is lost. The amount is based on the units power level (PL). 100 PL = 1 mana. 200 PL = 2 mana etc. It increases the chance of a comeback for players when they suffer a loss.

- Bugfix: Poison and Fatigue resulted in errors for certain type of abilities that evaluated state during the end turn phase.

notes.title: The brand new movement editor is here
notes.content:
[h1]Movement editor[/h1]
You can now create completely custom movement patterns for your units.

[h1]Ability editor[/h1]
Units can now use custom attributes, allowing you to create abilities that target these attributes. For example, if you create a set of sword wielding units, you can chose to buff them through your abilities, or how about destroying all undead units on the board? With attributes being plain text, you can create and affect new behaviors that you designed yourself.

[h3]Breaking changes[/h3]
Any abilities youve created that used the "With Type" will no longer work as expected. Please follow the following guide to fix them, or let us help you out in the forums or the discord channel.

1. Search for all "*.json" files in the games installation folder under StreamingAssets/Packs that contains the following text:

"TypeInfo": {

2. Rename "TypeInfo" to "AttributeInfo". It is very important that you dont introduce any extra spaces or lower/uppercase letters that doesnt match the examples.

3. The row right under it will start with "Type: ". Replace that whole row with the following row instead:

"Query": "Chess.Pawn"

4. You should now be able to open the unit in the ability editor, so that it can be edited again. Also, you can set it to any unit type you want from a list of predefined unit types. Some examples include: Chess.Pawn, Chess.Rook, Chess.Knight, Chess.Bishop, Chess.Queen, Chess.King.

tags.feature: You can now create completely custom movement patterns for your units.
Units can now use custom attributes, allowing you to create abilities that target these attributes.

notes.title: Wardens is coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We will be releasing a demo of Wardens during the upcoming Steam Next Fest June 16-22.
You will be able to try out the full experience (no time limits or limited content) and to create your own cards and decks that can be shared with friends (and used against them during matches) :)

These are the features you can expect to be available in the demo, before the full game release.
[list]
[*] Pre-made decks that showcases different features of the game.
[*] Create your own cards and decks.
[*] Practice Mode: Test your decks and strategies against an AI opponent before taking it online.
[*] Online Mode: Play against other players, either in a public game (that anyone can join), or in a private game where you invite specific players to join.
[*] Audio and video settings (support for ultrawide monitors).
[/list]
